title: Explore the Interface
description: Identify and label the main windows. Take a screenshot showing your customized layout.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Get comfortable with the editor layout.

1.  Open your `HelloUnity` project.
2.  Using the **Layout** dropdown, switch through a few presets (2 by 3, Tall, Default).
3.  Return to the Default layout.
4.  **Customize it**:
    *   Drag the **Game** tab next to the **Scene** tab so they are side by side.
    *   Move the **Console** to the bottom, next to the **Project** window.
5.  Save your layout as "My First Layout".
6.  Identify and list the six major windows: Scene, Game, Hierarchy, Inspector, Project, Console.
7.  Take a screenshot of your customized Editor with at least one object visible in the Scene (e.g., the default Directional Light).
hints: You can drag tabs by their title to reposition them. Blue highlights show where they will dock.
Use Window → Layouts → Save Layout to keep your arrangement.
expectedOutput: A screenshot of the customized editor with the six windows visible and labeled. A short written list (in a text file or comment) naming each window.
solutionCode: No code required. This is an interface exploration task.
